root_cause.statement: The verb SELECT routed to v_native_select, which drives a native <select id=options>. click-option has six radios and no #options. The driver found nothing, clicked nothing, and called submit(); the episode ended on a submit that selected nothing.
root_cause.the_solver_was_never_wrong: v_checkboxes called directly on the live page returned checkboxes:1 and reward 1. The route was wrong, not the matcher.
root_cause.class: SELECT had three page-specific drivers (menu, colour, native select) and no fallback. Any page in none of those three received a submit with nothing selected.

fix.one: radio in input kinds and 'select' in goal -> v_checkboxes
fix.two: SELECT with no #options -> candidate resolution, then submit only if the episode is not already over

full_sample.attribution_warning: drag-cube +4 is NOT attributable to this change. Nothing in this round touches dragging. The ups and downs together are the noise floor.

the_series_that_was_noise.note: No code change between most of these runs. 5 reps per task cannot distinguish a 0.55 policy from a 0.60 one.

law_added: A single-task fix is real and verifiable to 12/12. A 5-rep sample cannot resolve it in the total. A reach number at this n is not a capability number.
what_this_does_not_prove: that computer use is closer to solved -- this is one task class in one family of twelve open families
that the reach number improved -- the total moved by one trial out of two hundred
